Why Buy?Mutton Curry PasteMutton curry originating from Bengal is a popular cuisine in many Indian homes, though each region has its own variations. Mutton curry is prepared from mutton (or Lamb) and often cooked with vegetables. It can be served with rice or eaten with a form of Indian bread such as naan, roti, or chapati. Ingredients are onions, sunflower oil, kashmiri chilli, fresh garlic and ginger, salt and a small blend of other spices. Chicken Curry PasteChicken Curry is the most popular cuisine in the Indian subcontinent, though each region has its own variations and is popularized by all Indian settlers around the globe; including the Caribbean, the African continent, Mauritius, Fiji Islands etc. It can be served with rice or eaten with a form of Indian bread such as naan, roti, or chapati. Ingredients are onions, sunflower oil, kashmiri chilli, fresh garlic and ginger, salt and a small blend of other spices. Chicken Roast PasteChicken roast masala is a semi dry delicious blend of marinated Chicken. Another popular dish of India. As the name suggests made with chicken. Marinate the chicken with the mix and let the paste do its work for 1 hour and than fry or grille as per the instructions. Ingredients are coconut vinegar, green chillies, fresh garlic and ginger, salt and a small blend of other spices.Chicken ChettinadA popular dish introduced by the Chettinads, the spice traders from Tamil Nadu. Though not as popular as the other dishes in the pack, it is very popular in southern India. A semi dry dish is best marinated overnight or at least for 4-5 hours for the best results and than fry or grille as per the instructions. The dish is spicy, but the reduced addition of the masala to suit your spice tolerance is recommended. Ingredients are Red dry chillies, salt, sunflower oil, vinegar, garlic, ginger, and a small blend of other spices.
